evidence: your pipeline, inside of Close, if you have a sales call, even if, like, anybody that's booked on your calendar, whether the call happened or didn't happen, a custom activity needs to be updated inside of Close, every single one of them. We can't let that fall through the cracks

Anybody you already had a sales call with, anybody that you maybe didn't have a sales call with because they no-showed, put that on there, too. If they rescheduled, put it on there. All the dispositions need to be put in there.

flags.summary: An unlisted 'Love It or Leave It' one-month entry offer is in active use as a fallback for hesitant prospects and is endorsed by the manager as a standing tool, outside the $6,000/6mo and $9,000/12mo structure.

flags.summary: Manager coaches reps to present results as biologically guaranteed and to suppress any expressed uncertainty, scripting a full rebuttal built on that claim.
evidence: the main thing is wanting to make sure that we're actually reframing them and putting it back on them and showing them that like well dude like we've worked with thousands of clients and ultimately it's science like if you eat the food that we're saying to eat and you train this way do you really think you're not going to get good results

Make it not a question of like us getting the results and don't show any sort of uncertainty in yourself. Like have full conviction that we get results and it's science because we know it's science at the end of the day
If they eat the foods and they do the work. The result has to happen. It's human biology. It has to happen.
So what is it that's actually coming up that makes him think that it won't work for him? Like he's some special person that the laws of biology don't work for.

flags.summary: Manager scripts a line telling prospects the closer has no financial stake in the sale, when closers are paid on the close and were spending the meeting moving cash targets between weeks.

I'm here to protect the program and make sure that we put in people that are actually going to help us grow the program and actually get results for it. That's the truth.
